_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages (DMSMS) Subcontractor Health Report
summary: The DMSMS Subcontractor Health Report ensures DMSMS management capabilities are embedded within the contractor's subcontractors.
use_relationship:
The DMSMS Subcontractor Health Report is used to ensure DMSMS management capabilities are embedded within the contractor's subcontractors.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) 48 CFR 2.101 - Definitions. Available from the Government Publishing Office, https://www.govinfo.gov/app/details/CFR-2016-title48-vol1/CFR-2016-title48-vol1-sec2-101

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The DMSMS Subcontractor Health Report shall be in the contractor's format and provided electronically in Adobe Acrobat or Microsoft Word.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The DMSMS Subcontractor Health Report shall identify the health of subcontractor's DMSMS management programs, as described in SAE STD-0016A, section 3.2 and Appendix C, Section C.2. The report shall only include subcontractors who supply items which are not commercial items, as defined in 48 CFR 2.101-Definitions. The report shall identify subcontractor DMSMS management shortfalls that could impact production, life cycle sustainment, or technical refresh. If a subcontractor is deemed deficient in DMSMS management, the report shall include the actions that are being taken to mitigate that deficiency.
